entities.name: Archaic Greek Period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The period of ancient Greek history (c. 800-480 BCE) between the Dark Ages and the Classical period, during which the Greeks developed the polis (city-state), alphabetic writing, monumental architecture, Olympic games, philosophical inquiry, and colonized the Mediterranean from Spain to the Black Sea — laying the foundations of Western civilization.
